description.en: Peer communication between conversations open in the same DeepSeek Harness process: a conversation lists the peers the workspace shows, links one under a nickname, sends it a message without waiting for its turn to end, reads its progress without waking it, and declares standing rules for its own tool calls.
description.zh: 同一 DeepSeek Harness 进程内对话之间的对等通信：列出一个工作区里可见的对话、用昵称连接对方、给对方发消息且不必等它当前一轮结束、不唤醒对方地查看进度，并给自己声明常驻的工具调用规则。
